jobs.title: Senior Principal Product Manager - Infusion
jobs.description:
Work Location: This position is designated as remote. However, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

Overview:
We are seeking a licensed Pharmacist with direct clinical experience in intravenous/infusion therapy to join our team. The Senior Principal Product Manager supports the development of product strategy and roadmap, market and product requirements, and marketing plans for a specific product or products (s). This role will work to provide insight and recommendations to meet market demand, documented solutions to business problems, and works with the Client and Product Leadership as well as BA's, Developers, QA, Design and Support to ensure requirements are fully defined and the proposed approach is both agreeable and complete. The Senior Principal Product Manager represents the perspective of the customer focusing on operational efficiency, standard operating procedure, clinical best practices, change management, and end-user experiences. The Senior Principal Product Manager also participates in UI/UX design development and review, with a focus on pharmacy process optimization, in addition to supporting construction as appropriate. The Product Advisor works internally and may also work directly with the client if direct collaboration is required and helps to enable customers to achieve their stated goals and deliver on the overall product strategy.

Duties and Responsibilities:

 - Gathers, refines, and distills market feedback and market analysis to define requirements and document the solution approach, then iterates through adjustments to ensure alignment with company, client, and product strategy.

 - Collaborates with the Client Management, Product, and Architecture Teams to define the functional approach to delivering on the product vision and customer needs.

 - Accountable for the successful definition, delivery, and implementation of the solutions for which they provide advisement.

 - Escalate any project risks, impacts or client executive misalignments as they’re identified.

 - Integrated as part of the full product lifecycle * Sales Support & Pre-Sales Engineering * Client Advisory Board * Product Strategy & Vision * Product Planning * Construction * Go Live & Stabilization * Support

 - Collaborate with the Product Managers to support them in strategic road-mapping and product investing.

 - Review, understand, weigh-in & approve deliverables (requirements, designs, etc.).

 - Considered part of the product innovation team; creates a multitude of artifacts, including scope/approach documents for product and client initiatives.

 - Presents at internal training, product turnover, and knowledge sharing events as necessary.

 - Manage product management and marketing to perform win-loss analysis.

 - Collaborate with the marketing team to deliver positioning documents, marketing plan, and other go-to-market related activities.

 - Continuously perform competitive analysis and maintain expert-level knowledge of competitive landscape for the product.

 - Develop, perform, and coordinate internal product training for sales, client services, and solution engineer teams.

 - Review and approve product pricing and solution strategies for client purchases. Validating product budget against revenue and expenses on an ongoing basis.

 - Coordinate with technology and other groups to create timely client-facing communication and collaterals related to products.

 - Maintain compliance with lnovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement.

 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within lnovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position.

 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by lnovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company.

Education:
Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) required
Master’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (M.A./M.S.) preferred

Experience:

 - 8+ Years of experience in product marketing or product management areas, with a minimum 5 years of healthcare experience; system designs and concepts experience required

 - 5+ Years of healthcare experience; system designs and concepts experience required

 - Active State Board of Pharmacy License

 - Minimum of 10 years of clinical pharmacy experience in home infusion or ambulatory infusion suite IV compounding

 - Hands on experience with dosing, monitoring, and clinical assessment for therapies such as biologics, Parenteral Nutrition, IV antibiotics, hydration, and inotropes

 - Demonstrated proficiency with USP <797> standards and cleanroom operations

 

Skills and Abilities:

 - Strong communication, organizational, observational, design and engineering skills.

 - Proficient problem-solving skills with good judgment and decision making skills.

 - Strong project management skills.

 - Goal-Oriented with high attention to detail.

 - High familiarity with Microsoft Office.

 - Self-starter/motivated.

 - Ability to drive results.
   
   

Working Conditions and Physical Demands:
This is a primarily sedentary role. The employee is regularly required to sit, talk, and hear for extended periods of time, and also required to repetitively use manual labor to operate a computer keyboard and other office equipment.
The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, or lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 
 

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.

We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. jobs.title: Product Owner - Claims
Informatics Product Lead, RWD
jobs.description:
Overview: 

The Informatics Product Lead will serve as the primary Informatics partner to Product, Engineering, and Client Services teams for data-involved products, with initial emphasis on Inovalon’s de-identified data platform and RWD use cases. Reporting directly to the AVP, Informatics, this role is responsible for ensuring that data requirements, testing strategies, impact assessments, client escalations, and release sign-off processes incorporate a rigorous informatics lens without slowing product delivery. 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

 - Product Informatics Leadership: Serve as the Informatics lead for data platform and RWD product engagement, participating in data-involved design discussions, backlog grooming, requirements review, prioritization, testing strategy, and release readiness activities.

 - Client Services Escalation Support: Act as the Informatics support for client-reported data concerns, partnering with Client Services, Product, and Engineering to clarify issues, assess severity, determine likely root cause, and route work to relevant teams as appropriate.

 - Release Sign-Off Coordination: Coordinate Informatics review and sign-off for data-involved releases, including review of schema, logic, content, data quality evidence, impact analysis, and known risks within agreed-upon SLAs and escalation paths.

 - Testing and Impact Analysis: Define and execute informatics-informed test scenarios, acceptance criteria, regression checks, and impact assessments for clinical, membership, provider, source, and product logic changes.

 - Cross-Functional Requirements Translation: Translate clinical, data, and operational concerns into clear requirements, testable acceptance criteria, and decision-ready summaries for Product, Engineering, DQ Engineering, and leadership stakeholders.

 - Product Logic and Data Standards Review: Review product logic, source integration decisions, data transformations, and clinical/business rules to identify risks related to quality, usability, interpretation, consistency, and client-facing deliverables.

 - Continuous Improvement: Identify patterns in escalations and release reviews that should become reusable standards, test cases, documentation, data quality rules, or upstream product requirements.

 - Maintain compliance with Inovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement.

 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position.

 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company.

 - Uphold responsibilities relative to the separation of duties for applicable processes and procedures within your job function.

 - We reserve the right to change this job description from time to time as business needs dictate and will provide notice of such. 

Job Requirements: 

 - 8+ years of experience in healthcare data, clinical informatics, data quality, analytics, or a related field with a Bachelor's degree required; or

 - 5+ years of experience in healthcare data, clinical informatics, data quality, analytics, or a related field with a Master's degree required.

 - Healthcare Data Expertise: Strong working knowledge of claims, EHR, membership/enrollment, provider, clinical, and real-world data environments, including common data quality and interpretation challenges.

 - SQL Skills: Proficiency in SQL for querying, analyzing, validating, and explaining large-scale healthcare datasets and client-reported data issues.

 - Product Experience: Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams in agile environments, including backlog review, requirements clarification, acceptance criteria, testing, release readiness, and operational escalation management.

 - Communication: Ability to synthesize complex data issues into clear written summaries, executive-ready recommendations, client-ready explanations, and actionable requirements for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple escalations, release reviews, stakeholder requests, and product workstreams in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear prioritization and follow-through.

 - Preferred Experience: Experience supporting RWD products, clinical analytics products, data quality programs, client-facing healthcare platforms, identity management workflows, or data governance operating models preferred. 

 Education: 

 - Bachelor's Degree in Health Informatics, Medical Informatics, Computer Science, Health Information Management, Nursing, Pharmacy, Analytics, or a related field required.

 - Master's Degree in Medical Informatics, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, or a related discipline preferred.

 - Relevant professional certifications, such as AHIC, CPHIMS, RHIA, CCS, CHDA, or equivalent experience, a plus. 

Physical Demands and Work Environment: 

 - Sedentary work (i.e. sitting for long periods of time);

 - Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force;  

 - Frequently or constantly lift, carry push, pull or otherwise move objects and repetitive motions;

 - Subject to inside environmental conditions

 - Travel for this position will include less than 10-15% as needed to perform job responsibilities. 

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.

Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.

Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.

To review the California Consumer Privacy Statement: Disclosures for California Residents, please visit this link https://www.inovalon.com/privacy-policy/

Work Location: If the US position is listed as remote, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI/ML
jobs.description:
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.


Overview:
Senior Product Manager is responsible for managing key partner and platform integration products within the business unit product portfolio. This role is responsible for managing inputs from external and internal stakeholders, product planning, managing platform dependencies, leading cross functional teams for release and go-to-market plans and activities, enhancing and differentiating product within our core markets to best position the products within our markets and the competitive landscape. Interfaces with engineering, operations and sales to develop new products and enhance existing products.

Duties and Responsibilities:

 - Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for AI/ML-powered features, partnering with AI/ML Engineering & Data Science and to translate business problems into AI/ML use cases (e.g., predictive models, NLP, GenAI/LLM-based capabilities).

 - Own the AI product lifecycle — problem framing, model evaluation criteria, data requirements, responsible AI/bias review, and go-to-market — in collaboration with Data Science, Engineering, and Legal/Compliance.

 - Define success metrics and KPIs for AI/ML features (accuracy, precision/recall, latency, adoption, business ROI) and monitor post-launch model performance in partnership with Data Science.

 - Champion responsible AI practices — data privacy, explainability, bias mitigation, and regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA) — in product design.

 - Develop business cases to justify investment required to build, partner or buy.

 - Be the trusted thought leader for your product area; being the ‘voice of the market/customer’ within Inovalon and externally with customer interactions and events.

 - Build and maintain roadmap for products and work with cross-functional teams to deliver a unified product plan to the market.

 - Work with Marketing and Sales to define the go-to-market strategy, product positioning, and pricing strategies.

 - Develop, drive and coordinate complex product priorities in a fast-paced environment with intra-team and inter-team dependencies.

 - Develop and implement a company-wide commercialization and launch plan for the products within the product line, working with all departments and the Product PMO to execute.

 - Translate product strategy into requirements and prototypes, and then work with architects, developers and customers to implement these features.

 - Serve as a product evangelist with Marketing, Sales, and the go-to-market organization to confirm the vision, roadmap and best practices are understood.

 - Analyze and manage to product metrics/KPI’s that inform the success of your products in the market.

 - Maintain compliance with lnovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement.

 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within lnovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position.

 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by lnovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company.

 - Uphold responsibilities relative to the separation of duties for applicable processes and procedures within your job function.

 - We reserve the right to change this job description from time to time as business needs dictate and will provide notice of such.



Education:

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) in relevant field required


Experience:

 - 5+ Years of Software Product Management experience managing platform or integration products required

 - 5+ Years of healthcare information technology experience with a focus on partner integration products required

 - Minimum of 3 years’ experience in Agile development methodologies required


Skills and Abilities:

 - Experience managing AI/ML or data-driven products, with working knowledge of the AI/ML lifecycle (data collection, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring etc).

 - Familiarity with GenAI/LLM technologies and their application to enterprise/healthcare products preferred.
   Ability to collaborate effectively with Data Science/ML Engineering teams and translate technical AI concepts for business and executive audiences.

 - Experience with Pragmatic Marketing or Certified in Pragmatic Marketing.

 - Proven to perform strategically and execute operationally.

 - Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams from product concept to reference customers.

 - Proven track record of creating and launching new products.

 - SaaS or cloud software experience.

 - Proficient in Microsoft Office suite including Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint.

 - Self-motivated with strong organizational/prioritization skills and ability to multi-task with close attention to detail.

 - Excellent written and oral presentation skills.

 - Ability to work in a fast- paced environment.


Working Conditions and Physical Demands:

 - This is a primarily sedentary role. The employee is regularly required to sit, talk, and hear for extended periods of time, and also required to repetitively use manual labor to operate a computer keyboard and other office equipment.

 - The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, or lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.



Travel Expectations:
Travel for this position will include less than 10% locally usually for training purposes.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

jobs.title: Director of Product (Real World Data)
jobs.description:
Work Location: This position is designated as remote. However, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).


Overview:
The Director, Product Management will provide leadership in the development and execution of business strategy for the Company's product growth across multiple solutions/services. Contributing inputs into financial forecasts and results, the Incumbent will transform business and market strategies into solutions for problems that are urgent, pervasive and that the market will pay to solve. Incumbent will own market research and infuse thought leadership across business units and cross-functional teams throughout product development, launch, and ongoing service provision. In addition to the performance of such other services assigned or delegated by the Company, the Incumbent will communicate to key stakeholders, including the Executive Leadership Team, and will engage with customers and business partners to understand new market needs, as well as define roadmaps, product requirements, operational standards for execution and sales. The Incumbent will demonstrate technical expertise, as well as product management discipline, to bring cutting-edge solutions and assets to market, resulting in delighted customers and sustained growth.

Business Unit: Inovalon Insights

Duties and Responsibilities:

 - For commercially facing solutions/services, own design of a strategic, multi-year business plan and blueprint to meet the product goals around key metrics (e.g., revenue, EBIDTA).

 - Facilitate a regular review/update cadence (no less than quarterly) and help ensure revenue attainment.

 - Conducts research to evaluate market landscape, technologies, industry, and competitive trends.

 - Engage with customers, users, internal stakeholders, and business partners to drive requirements and roadmap and product vision, while understanding the Company’s distinctive competencies.

 - Own functional requirements, User Journeys, workflows and use case scenarios, prioritization of requirements, tradeoffs based on partnering with Engineering.

 - Provide market-driven requirements to engineering for a long-term scalable architecture.

 - Own completeness and review of all scoped requirements at the release and product portfolio level and maintenance of all requirements in Agile-development tools.

 - Maintain a published roadmap outlining ideas, value, and timing of those to market, as well as the fit within the product portfolio.

 - Design and/or partner on solutions and services – driving early-stage technologies, supporting design-led research, reviewing prototype development, and finalizing fit into the product portfolio.

 - Support definition of contract terms and templates and ensure solution/service compliance, including data policies, during definition and early-stage phases.

 - Support Solutions Marketing relative to positioning, messaging, and launch of solutions/services.

 - Support Operations and Customer Support relative to execution.

 - Support Sales and Customer Success, on opportunity development and closure – when complexity and need for subject matter expertise are present.

 - Maintain compliance with lnovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement.

 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within lnovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position.

 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by lnovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company.

 - Uphold responsibilities relative to the separation of duties for applicable processes and procedures within your job function.

 - We reserve the right to change this job description from time to time as business needs dictate and will provide notice of such.


Education:

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) required

 - Master’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (M.A./M.S.) in relevant fields preferred


Experience:

 - 12+ Years of experience with demonstrable accomplishments in technical product management in software and development of novel software products in healthcare and life sciences technologies required

 - 6+ Years of experience leading product management business strategy, financial/business modeling and analysis, business plan development, market/industry research, and competitive analysis required

 - Proven track record in building new software products and introducing them to market

 - Experience writing specs, creating a roadmap, driving engineering

o Proven track record building, commercializing, or applying real-world data (RWD) — whether as a product leader at a data aggregator/licensor, or as a researcher/analyst building commercial, operational, or clinical data products for biopharma

o Deep fluency in the core RWD asset classes, open and closed medical claims, pharmacy claims, EHR/clinical data, lab and mortality data and a working understanding of how each is sourced, refreshed, and licensed

o Firsthand experience navigating data licensing and permissibility constraints (HIPAA de-identification, DUAs, data use restrictions, re-identification risk) well enough to make product tradeoffs.

o Track record scoping data products or analyses against real HEOR/RWE and market access use cases and translating those needs into data requirements.

o Understands population representativeness, capture bias, linkage rates, refresh cadence and can defend or challenge a dataset's suitability for a specific analytic use case

o Experience partnering with data science/informatics teams on data quality, curation, and taxonomy/classification frameworks.

o Has worked directly with biopharma commercial, HEOR, RWE, or medical affairs stakeholders (or their equivalents) and can speak their language on evidence generation timelines and deliverable formats


Skills and Abilities:

 - Visionary leader, ability to manage a “whole product” and lead virtual teams

 - Cloud-based product acumen

 - Experience working with healthcare data & defining novel healthcare workflows

 - 'Get things done attitude’ along with great organizational skills

 - Mastery of Agile process, Jira or vsts, confluence or similar tools


Working Conditions and Physical Demands:

 - This is a primarily sedentary role. The employee is regularly required to sit, talk, and hear for extended periods of time, and also required to repetitively use manual labor to operate a computer keyboard and other office equipment.

 - The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, or lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Travel for this position may be seasonal for specific product lines which may lead to concentrations of travel during specific periods of the year, but generally should not exceed 25% on an annual basis

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Senior Product Manager is responsible for managing key partner and platform integration products within the business unit product portfolio. This role is responsible for managing inputs from external and internal stakeholders, product planning, managing platform dependencies, leading cross functional teams for release and go-to-market plans and activities, enhancing and differentiating product within our core markets to best position the products within our markets and the competitive landscape. Interfaces with engineering, operations and sales to develop new products and enhance existing products.

 

Essential Functions:

Be the trusted thought leader for your product area; being the ‘voice of the market/customer’ within Inovalon and externally with customer interactions and events.

Build and maintain roadmap for products and work with cross-functional teams to deliver a unified product plan to the market.

Work with Marketing and Sales to define the go-to-market strategy, product positioning, and pricing strategies.

Develop, drive and coordinate complex product priorities in a fast-paced environment with intra-team and inter-team dependencies.

Develop and implement a company-wide commercialization and launch plan for the products within the product line, working with all departments and the Product PMO to execute.

Translate product strategy into requirements and prototypes, and then work with architects, developers and customers to implement these features.

Serve as a product evangelist with Marketing, Sales, and the go-to-market organization to confirm the vision, roadmap and best practices are understood.

Analyze and manage to product metrics/KPI’s that inform the success of your products in the market.

 

Work Experience:

10+ Years of Software Product Management experience managing platform or integration products

5+ Years of healthcare information technology experience with a focus on partner integration products

Minimum of 3 years’ experience in Agile development methodologies

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) in relevant field
